title: Caacaytuk Afal Tan Xongolo
intro: Bacari addat tan muuci ugteh caylale agat numma fan yadaaroonuh. ummatta elle tamixxigem sinni qaxmeqe xisneenaa kee qeedaalisso sinni maqar. Tah fanah ken kaxxiina inti maleela ken hayteeh, oson ankacisaanam cineenih. Ellecaboh, finqa digaala keenil radde, dubuk qunxa butta yaamineenim cabteh.
clues: Anu fakut tan baaxooxal mannowtaah, ken caylah tamixxigeh tan caylale mara fan ruube.
Yi ummatta finqitteh sugte gersi kaxxa agattiinah lakal temeete.
Oson qaxmeqe rikkissoosa luk sugeenim kee fayyale kalqatitte xisen.
Anu inki Yalla akah taamitannah ken seece, takkay immay oson sinni sanamitte cabaanam cineenih.
yollih yaamine mara dubuk cattiimak qanxaffe le digaala keenil radde.
Anu Aad deqsita caylale ummattah ruube numu.

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Yi ummatta finqitteh caylale silaytut, anu cattiime wak
Yi ummatta ardi angoyyat raddeeh weeqte
outcome.answer: Yi ummatta finqitteh caylale silaytut, anu cattiime wak

arabic: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَن جَآءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ لِيُنذِرَكُمْ ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍۢ وَزَادَكُمْ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ بَصْۜطَةًۭ ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ ءَالَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verse: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allāh that you might succeed." (7:69)
